newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says opposes special tax treatment for NTT.
newsitem.headline: MOF says opposes special tax treatment for NTT.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) opposes granting special tax treatment to Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) that would allow it to pay taxes on a consolidated basis, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday.

NTT has requested that it be allowed to pay taxes on a consolidated basis beginning in the fiscal year from April 1998, to coincide with the lifting of the Anti-monopoly Law"s ban on holding companies.
"We should not allow it (consolidated tax payment) only for NTT. It is important that taxes should be fair and equal," Mitsuzuka told a news conference.
